answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in ocean, expire in kernel, and summit lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 156 aliases as a result needs 134 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1087 identities would post 3787 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
